Node 2: Recursive stripping of prior discounted coupons
Node 3: Isolation of final payment to solve next zero rate

scenes.visualIntent: Step-by-step bootstrapping of 6-month zero rate from a Treasury bill trading at 97.50 dollars

scenes.visualIntent: Interactive formula breakdown calculating 1-year forward rate starting at year 1 from 3% and 4% zero rates
keyElements: forward rate formula R_F = (R_2*T_2 - R_1*T_1) / (T_2 - T_1)

scenes.visualIntent: Term structure chart showing upward sloping zero curve and the implied forward curve lying strictly above it
keyElements: Horizontal axis: Maturity in years (0 to 5 years)
Vertical axis: Annual interest rate percentage (0% to 8%)
Zero curve starting at 3.0% for 1 year and 4.0% for 2 years
Forward curve plotted above spot curve reaching 5.0% for year 2
